identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Adebrelimab in Combination with Chemo with or Without Bevacizumab Neoadjuvant Therapy for Resectable NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Phase II Study of Adebrelimab in Combination with Chemotherapy with or Without Bevacizumab Neoadjuvant Therapy for Resectable Non-Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

leadSponsor.name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective, multicenter, randomized, uncontrolled Phase II study to assess the efficacy and safety of adebrelimab in combination with chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab for the treatment of resectable Stage II-IIIB (T3N2) NSQ-NSCLC and to explore biomarkers associated with efficacy.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Neoadjuvant therapy with experimental treatment followed by surgery.

armGroups.label: four-drug combination group
armGroups.description: PD-L1 inhibitor with chemotherapy with Antiangiogenic therapy for neoadjuvant therapy

armGroups.label: three-drug combination group
armGroups.description: PD-L1 inhibitor with chemotherapy for neoadjuvant therapy

interventions.name: Platinum-based chemotherapy
interventions.description: paclitaxel or albuminotaxol or docetaxel combined with platinum, pemetrexed combined with platinum. Platinums include carboplatin, cisplatin and nedaplatin.

primaryOutcomes.description: Pathological complete response, pCR (primary tumor + lymph nodes).It refers to the proportion of subjects with no residual surviving tumor cells (including lymph nodes) in the postoperative specimen among the enrolled subjects
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After 4 cycles of neoadjuvant therapy(3 weeks per cycle), surgical resection was performed at intervals of 4-6 weeks. Pathological response assessment results were assessed within one week after surgery.

secondaryOutcomes.description: It refers to the proportion of subjects with residual surviving tumor cells of ≤ 10% in the postoperative specimen among the enrolled subjects.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After 4 cycles of neoadjuvant therapy(3 weeks per cycle), surgical resection was performed at intervals of 4-6 weeks. Pathological response assessment results were assessed within one week after surgery.

secondaryOutcomes.description: It refers to the proportion of patients whose tumor shrinks to a certain extent and maintains it for a certain period of time, including CR and PR cases.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After 4 cycles of neoadjuvant therapy(3 weeks per cycle), before surgical resection was performed（at intervals of 4-6 weeks）.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as disease progression from randomization to imaging confirmation, local progression leading to inoperable tumors, unresectable tumors, local or distant recurrence, and death from any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from randomization to imaging confirmation, local progression leading to inoperable tumors, unresectable tumors, local or distant recurrence, and death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 24 months.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Monitoring and recording of adverse events, including Incidence of serious adverse events and adverse events of special interest.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Safety follow-up will be conducted 30 ± 7 days after the last use of bevacizumab/chemotherapy or 90 ± 7 days after the last use of adebrelimab/surgery (whichever occurs later) to track the relief of AE. Incidence of AE/SAE/TRAE will be recorded.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Resectable NSQ NSCLC
* Age 18-65 years
* male or female
* ECOG 0-1
* Subjects have not received surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy and biological treatment of treatment-naive non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
* Subjects must have adequate pulmonary function for the intended pneumonectomy;

Exclusion Criteria:

* SCLC or SQ NSCLC
* previously used anti-PD1, anti-PDL1, anti-CTLA4 antibodies, etc.
* patients who have previously used anti-angiogenic drugs;
* allergic to any component of the study drug or chemotherapy drugs
* patients with any severe and or uncontrolled disease

locations.facility: Department of Thoracic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University
